# Design tokens

<!-- Generated by scripts/brand_tokens.py from frontend/src/ui/tokens.css. Do not edit; run `python3 scripts/brand_tokens.py`. -->

The dashboard's tokens, as `frontend/src/ui/tokens.css` defines them. Every brand asset takes its colours, type, spacing and radii from that file. *Same* means the dark theme keeps the light value.
